Name: Epic Gheegur

Description.name: Epic Gheegur
Description.description: The custom of crafting and gifting stuffed animals is a timed-honored tradition, dating back to the days of the Dawn of Fire. Those ones usually weren't possessed by a rambunctious Wublin spirit, however - this Epic attempt to cutesify the Gheegur can be considered successful IF and only if you subscribe to Supernatural design sensibilities. Then, it's head and shoulders above the others.

Combinations to Breed: Zap The Eggs Needed To Fill Epic Gheegur
